title: Synapse crash
body:
Synapse crashes. After about 4 hours of work.
Not exactly crashes, in fact. There's an error in the log, but it still hangs in the memory, eating around 100% of CPU. No responses on any requests.

Synapse version: v0.17.0  Haven't seen such behaviour on older versions.
OS: Linux (Linux 4.6.1-2-ARCH x86_64)

Synapse was run with the following command:
`/usr/bin/python2.7 -m synapse.app.homeserver --config-path=/etc/synapse/homeserver.yaml --verbose`

Crash dump:
